title: MES
tagline: A Windows launcher built for speed. Alt+Space, type, find anything instantly.
description: MES is a lightweight app launcher for Windows inspired by Spotlight and Raycast. It indexes your apps and files so you can launch them in keystrokes — no mouse needed. Built with Python and a focus on sub-100ms response times.

title: ChatChat
tagline: A no-build chat UI for local and cloud LLMs. Chat, story mode, streaming markdown — all in one tab.
description: ChatChat is a single-file HTML chat interface that connects to any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. It supports chat history, story generation mode, streaming markdown rendering, and theme switching. Zero dependencies, zero build step — just open and chat.
